name: Nullcorp // No Masters Anti-Corp Protest Wrap
description:
A large-format utility wrap — part coat, part banner — constructed from reclaimed billboard substrate and heat-bonded protest-print panels. The outer face rotates through three static screen-printed messages using thermochromic ink activated by body heat: CORPONATIONS ARE NOT CITIZENS, ΦΦΦΦ BUYS YOUR SILENCE, and a QR-analog grid that links to encrypted anti-corponation broadcast channels. Construction is deliberately rough — raw edges, exposed seams, misaligned panels — as aesthetic rejection of corporate finish.

The inner face is plain reclaimed thermal fleece, warm and functional. Sized generously to layer over anything. The wrap closes with salvaged industrial clips rather than any branded hardware.
functionality: Thermochromic panels cycle messages with body heat. Inner fleece provides Shelf-adequate insulation against acid rain and cold. Oversized cut layers over aug rigs and gene modifications. Clips allow rapid removal and reuse as ground sheet or barrier.
what_it_says: This person is not afraid to be seen saying something the corponations don't want heard.
price_range: Φ15–Φ60 (sliding scale, often distributed free at actions)
story_hooks: The QR-analog grid on a batch of wraps was quietly updated by an unknown party to link to a corponation honeypot — activists wearing them are being tracked.
A Tier 4 corporate security analyst is tasked with identifying the Nullcorp collective's leadership by tracing the billboard substrate back to its source.
A player character receives one of these wraps as a gift from a contact — wearing it in certain districts marks them as an ally, but also as a target.

physical_description.visual_profile: An oversized, deliberately unfinished wrap that drapes heavily across the shoulders and torso like a protest banner made wearable. The silhouette is deliberately shapeless and anti-fashion—a rejection of corpo tailoring. When worn, it reads as equal parts garment and political statement, with raw edges catching light and thermochromic text shifting across the outer surface in response to body heat.
physical_description.fit: Generously oversized and intentionally unstructured. Designed to layer over any base garment without conformity. The wrap hangs loose, capable of being worn as a coat, draped asymmetrically, or cinched with the industrial clips at varying points. The massive format makes it adaptable to multiple body types and wearing styles.
physical_description.primary_material: Reclaimed billboard substrate (vinyl-coated polyester composite) bonded to heat-responsive thermochromic print panels on the outer face; plain reclaimed thermal fleece on the inner face for function and warmth.
physical_description.texture: Deliberately rough and unfinished. Outer surface has visible screen-print texture with slight ink buildup. Raw, unsewn edges. Exposed seams where panels meet. Heat-bonded joints show subtle ridging. Inner fleece is soft, napped, and worn-comfortable. Overall tactile impression is anti-smooth, anti-refined.
physical_description.color_scheme: Predominantly muted billboard substrate tones—grays, tans, weathered earth tones—with bold, high-contrast screen-printed text in black and white. Thermochromic ink shifts from dark to bright when activated by body heat, making protest messages appear and fade. The inner fleece is charcoal or faded black.
physical_description.closures: Salvaged industrial clips (repurposed from construction or machinery, chrome or steel finish) positioned at intervals along the front edges. Clips allow variable closure—can be fastened tight, left loose, or closed asymmetrically. No branded hardware; intentional rejection of corporate fastener aesthetics.
distinctive_features: Three rotating thermochromic screen-printed messages activated by body heat: CORPONATIONS ARE NOT CITIZENS, ΦΦΦΦ BUYS YOUR SILENCE, and an encrypted QR-analog grid
Reclaimed billboard substrate construction—visible seams between misaligned panels
Salvaged industrial clip closures with no branding
Anti-corporate aesthetic—deliberately lacks finish and polish
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 5 sub-grade / anti-establishment. The garment actively rejects corporate polish and tier signaling. Wearing it signals explicit rejection of corpo hierarchy and alignment with underground resistance movements.
physical_description.cultural_context: Street activist, anti-corporate resistance cell, protest movement participant, or sympathizer. This garment is a wearable political manifesto. Wearing it signals commitment to Nullcorp ideology and rejection of corpo citizenship. Found in ungoverned zones, black markets, and encrypted activist networks. Likely illegal or heavily surveilled in corpo-controlled GLMZ sectors.
physical_description.condition_typical: Perpetually weathered and patched. Raw edges fray slightly with wear. Heat-bonded seams may separate gradually. Thermochromic ink fades over time. The worn, unfinished aesthetic is intentional and only deepens with use. Stains, creases, and damage are embraced as signs of active use in the resistance.
